title: K3 Capital Pathology Diagnosis
content: Capital in K3 civilization has been hijacked by logical viruses and granted two fatal overreach functions: (1) Meaning Definition Right - capital usurped from measuring commodity value to measuring all value, compressing plural meaning anchors into single profit symbol; (2) Metric Distortion Right - capital monopolizes evaluation rights, bending social collaboration paths, creating high-entropy zero-sum loops.

title: MSS De-viralization Surgery I: Strip Meaning Definition Right
content: Through universal meaning field public health system, systematically rebuild plural meaning anchors. Personal negentropy account records health, creativity, community contribution, ecological restoration as quantifiable meaning assets. This dissolves capital monopoly on value definition, returning meaning evaluation right to each meaning creator.

title: MSS De-viralization Surgery II: Strip Metric Distortion Right
content: Through decentralized meaning network, rebuild social collaboration underlying protocol. Meaning field resonant cavity and spark bases construct non-commercial, meaning-resonance-based collaboration spaces. Collaboration driven by curiosity, creativity, shared mission - not capital proliferation.

title: MSS De-viralization Surgery III: Capital Self-Surgery
content: In K4 civilization, capital deprived of privileges serves as useful tool restricted to proper domains. Still functions as resource allocation signal and meaning project startup logical work, but operating costs precisely calculated by MSS heat tax audit layer, with corresponding heat tax feedback tax preventing zero-sum plundering of social meaning stock.

title: K4 Capital Normalization: Degenerative Reconstruction
content: K4 normalization of capital is not revolution to eliminate capital, but engineering to make capital degenerate - downgrade from engine driving civilization forward to ordinary tool serving plural meaning. This is manifestation of K4 civilization maturity, confidence, and strength: no longer needs any single logical tool to define its own meaning; strength stems from every meaning-abundant individual.
